page_title: NOT 0-1 LIV | Nottingham Forest v Liverpool 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Felipe (Nottingham) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexis Mac Allister swings the ball deep into the box and finds Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
90+9' There's an opportunity for Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

90+8' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
90+4' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) will take a corner kick.
90+4' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilo (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes it short.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) a deserved yellow card.
90+2' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Nottingham win a corner.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+1' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

89' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
88' Matz Sels (Nottingham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
86' Looks like Matz Sels (Nottingham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
85' Jayden Danns (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
84' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) replacing Conor Bradley.
84' Substitution. Jayden Danns (Liverpool) replaces Cody Gakpo.

83' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
79' Danilo (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch after Nicolas Dominguez signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
76' That's the end of the game for Harvey Elliott, who is replaced by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:15.
73' What a chance that is! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
70' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
68' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) launches a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels is alert to thwart the effort.
67' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
66' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
65' Substitution. Divock Origi walks off the pitch and Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) comes on as a substitute.
63' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
62' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
60' Here is a change. Bobby Clark is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Andrew Robertson can be given a rest.
59' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) for his blatant foul.
58' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
57' The corner is swung in but Liverpool can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
54' Liverpool enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
51' Having seen unsporting behavior, Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Felipe (Nottingham) is the recipient.
51' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Matz Sels sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
50' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.

50' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
48' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
47' A pass lands at the feet of Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
46' Referee Paul Tierney blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
40' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
36' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
32' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
31' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

27' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
26' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

25' What an amazing save by Caoimhin Kelleher! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but fails.
24' Bobby Clark (Liverpool) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
23' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
21' The possession of the ball – 26:74.
18' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

17' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.

15' Divock Origi (Nottingham) showcases his fine individual ability by beating a couple of players and hits a good long-range shot. The keeper has to scramble but the ball flies just past the right post.
10' Bobby Clark (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
6' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
4' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Divock Origi (Nottingham). The referee points to the corner flag and Nottingham will take a corner.
1' The first half has started.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Paul Tierney will referee today's match.
